description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that demonstrates the use of ActionBarCompat with a customized theme. It sets up an activity with a split action bar and three tabs for navigation, handling tab selection events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating the use of ActionBarCompat with tabs and a custom theme.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the action bar with three tabs.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the specified menu resource.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Callback for when a tab is selected.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Callback for when a tab is unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Callback for when a tab is reselected.
